review.identity: deepseek-1 (reviewer; same agent name and model as the implementer, fresh session context - not an independent review)
review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR set); this report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in component-table.json. MEASURED (identifiers, numbers, counts and digests only, no original display text, no script text): the mount layout the installation's two ordnance screens declare, read through cs_assets' production ROF mount and cs_formats' bounded member decoder and parsed from the screens' own `object <array>[n]` declarations and their fill loops - eight rocket slots (object RKA[8], for (BA = 0; BA < 8; BA++)), four gun/ammunition slots (object QKA[4], for (BA = 0; BA < 4; BA++)) and two hardpoint points (object DT[2], for (R = 0; R < 2; R++)), each bound stated twice and agreeing, and each ordnance array deactivating its own empty slot (RKA and QKA each call deactivate on it; HARDPOINTS.SCRIPT has no deactivate and always shows both points). Per component, cs_content::ordnance::read_original_component_table reads every weapon record T452.01's stated rules classify (sixteen: twelve guided, two area-denial, one torpedo, one proximity flak) and records what the record itself declares: VELOCITY, FIRE_RATE, CLUSTER_SIZE, IMPACT_PROXIMITY, ARMOR_DAMAGE/HEALTH_DAMAGE/DAMAGE, DETONATION_TIME, and each status/effect flag with the duration the key carries (TANGLER 2 s, SMOKE_SCREEN 8 s, BEEPER 20 s, all with the TIME unit word); the thirty-two records no family rule reaches (the thirty-one CANNON machine and turret guns, and the cannonball wep_28) are listed by name and excluded rather than lowered. NOT CLAIMED: any original-run behavior (retail is read access, no agent ran the original); the per-airframe layout (which component fills which slot on a given plane) is in the plane records in the engine image and is recorded as the named unknown t452_04.limit.per_airframe_layout; the VELOCITY unit (t452_04.limit.velocity_unit, fifteen records), what FIRE_RATE delays and in which direction (t452_04.limit.release_delay, sixteen records), the projectile lifetime (the member carries no EXPIRES key at all: t452_04.limit.no_expires_key, fifteen records), the area-denial effect's radius for the two records that state no area (t452_04.limit.area_radius, two records) and the area's lifetime (t452_04.limit.area_lifetime, fifteen records), the status effect's gameplay kind (t452_04.limit.status_effect_kind, seven records), a status effect's missing duration (t452_04.limit.status_effect_duration, four records), which slot holds a record with no ROCKET flag (t452_04.limit.rocket_flag_missing, wep_25), and what each clustered sub-munition does (the carried t454.limit.swarm, eleven records). Every value the member does state is recorded exactly as stored, including the f32 rounding the writer left in FIRE_RATE (wep_10's 0.3 is 0.30000001192092896). The claim is implemented: a code and test pass awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
